messages:
Marta (Acme): Hey team—we just noticed our free trial credits (250 USD) show up on an old inactive workspace `acme-sandbox-2020` instead of our main org `acme-prod`. We didn't touch that sandbox in years.
Priya (CS): Sorry about that — can you DM me the org_id for acme-prod and the workspace id for the sandbox? Also a screenshot of the billing page would help.
Marta (Acme): org_id: org-acme-prod-42, sandbox workspace id: ws-acme-sandbox-2020. Screenshot attached in DM. The admin email is marta@acme.com.
Priya (CS): Thanks — looping in SRE and Billing to investigate rapid fix and reassign. @Eli @Jorge
Eli (SRE): Looking now. Quick note: we recently saw SSO NameID normalization cause duplicates for other customers. Will check mapping for their SAML external_id.
Eli (SRE): Runbook check: found grant entry where grant_id = GRT-202-88 bound to workspace ws-acme-sandbox-2020. Created 2020-08-17 by promo-import job. Query: `SELECT grant_id, amount, bound_workspace_id, created_by FROM credits WHERE grant_id='GRT-202-88';` -> shows amount=250.00, bound_workspace_id=ws-acme-sandbox-2020
Eli (SRE): Reason appears to be SSO import created a duplicate workspace record with slightly different external_id after a SAML change. The promo was applied at grant time to the duplicate record.
Jorge (Billing): We can reassign the promo grant from the inactive workspace to the active org. Internal admin endpoint exists for this. Example command (do not paste admin token in public channels):
```
curl -s -X POST https://internal.redwood/api/admin/credits/reassign \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <ADMIN_TOKEN>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"grant_id":"GRT-202-88","to_org_id":"org-acme-prod-42","reason":"SSO duplicate workspace reassign"}'
```
Priya (CS): Jorge/Eli — can one of you run the reassignment now? Please confirm when visible in Marta's account. Also record ticket for follow-up root cause.
Eli (SRE): Executing now via internal console (admin token used). Response: `{"status":"ok","grant_id":"GRT-202-88","moved_amount":250.00,"from_workspace":"ws-acme-sandbox-2020","to_org":"org-acme-prod-42"}`
Eli (SRE): Also set a temporary manual lock on ws-acme-sandbox-2020 so the promo can't be reactivated. Audit note added.
Marta (Acme): I can confirm the 250 USD trial credit is showing in acme-prod billing page now. Thank you! :white_check_mark:
Priya (CS): Great — closing the immediate ticket. Action items: (1) Jorge to confirm billing ledger correct and update invoice preview; (2) Eli to file an SSO dedupe bug (link to internal ticket RID-4523) and add external_id normalization on import; (3) CS to reach out to customer for closure and doc their steps.
Jorge (Billing): Ledger reconciled, no double-charges. I'll attach the ledger snapshot to the ticket.
Eli (SRE): Filed RID-4523 — root cause: SAML NameID variations created duplicate workspace rows when external_id case/format changed. Plan: on import, match existing external_id with relaxed normalization (lowercase, strip spaces) and emit a warning instead of creating new workspace. ETA: next sprint.
Priya (CS): Thanks everyone. Marta, I'll follow up with a short postmortem and confirm the customer-facing explanation. Apologies for the hassle.
AuditBot: Note — admin reassign recorded by user eli with activity id ACT-8892 at 1999991131."
